file_inventory_result.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of complete PNG file bytes
file_inventory_result.inventory_digest_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted [client-relative POSIX file path, file SHA-256] pairs, ensure_ascii=false and separators=(comma,colon).
file_inventory_result.limitation: Different PNG file SHA-256 values prove byte differences only. They do not prove distinct decoded pixels, genuine limb motion, correct running mechanics, readable arm swing, phase consistency, or visual acceptance.
